decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
fact: The setup of the suspension has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The setup was modified whilst the car was in parc fermé with the approval of the Technical Delegate further to a written request. The suspension setup has been changed from that previously used in Qualifying. The competitor is therefore required to start the race from the pit lane per article 40.9 c) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 77 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
to: The Team Manager, Alfa Romeo F1 Team Kick
